batch: WL82 - Incident-dependent Energy vs. Refraction-conditioned Angular Representation
status_rule: Frozen and committed together with the WL82 code before any candidate (E / Einc / ER) evaluation and before any WL82 fit or evaluation on any set. The dev smoke (--dev: 16 gate materials, reduced samples) runs before the freeze to check execution, memory and timing only; its quality numbers are not interpreted and not reported as evidence. Amendments are labelled, dated and state whether they precede or follow evidence.
question: Does correcting incident-dependent energy explain WL81's representation failure, or is a refraction-aware angular mechanism required to represent the tested layered responses?

hypotheses.H1: Incident-dependent energy modulation is sufficient to recover the target fidelity.
hypotheses.H2: After energy is corrected, the existing angular basis remains insufficient; a refraction-aware angular mechanism is necessary for the tested cases.

inputs.wl81_code: 54695d6 (experiments/fnto_compiled81/, unchanged; imported, not copied: closure81 horizon-safe runtime, data81 reference walks / directional sets, eval81 highlight / strata / representation gate, energy81 WL81 candidate compile for the historical fits)
inputs.wl81_reference: coated_conductor_layered_v1 (layered81.py), qualified in WL81 Stage A0; reproduction is re-checked here (stage R)
inputs.wl81_data: LabServer63 ~/rest_compiled81/results/data (sha256 list results/fnto_compiled81/results/data_sha256.txt): materials.npz, eval_gate / eval_test_iid / eval_test_block.npz (8 theta x 2 phi x 1024 wo, 4096 walks, halves), hl_gate / hl_test_iid.npz (highlight grids, 1024 walks)
inputs.wl81_fits: ~/rest_compiled81/results/C/fit/direct_{control,candidate,unbounded}_gate.npz (WL81 frozen Stage C direct fits; Stage A item A)
inputs.holdout_status: Verified 2026-11-10 before this protocol: test_iid / test_block (and train / val / train_eval) were generated in WL81 Stage A1 and read only by the reference pipeline (highlight phis, shard merge, noise floor) and by the sha256 listing (atime 10:43 UTC = data_sha256.txt); no candidate, control, fit or visual ever read them (chain.status: Stage D not reached; post hoc diagnostic and visuals used the gate set only). They are the independent evaluation sets of WL82. The gate set is development data (inspected in WL81).

machine.rule: One detached chain (run82.sh) covers every stage end to end; independent jobs inside a stage run as parallel processes; the session only observes.

invariants: WL81 reference definition, material population and split identities
WL81 evaluation metrics (E_L1, E_alb, highlight) and thresholds as a historical comparison point
WL81 corrected horizon-safe runtime (closure81) for every lobe
R = 8 lobes (Lambert + 7 anisotropic GGX) for every arm; no rank increase
no learned compiler, no FNTO / production change, no renderer integration

closures.raw_layout: 64 floats: [0:48] WL81 R = 8 raw parameters; [48:63] attenuation knots s_c(mu_j) (sigmoid, [0, 1]), c = RGB, mu_j = cos(theta) knots [0, 0.15, 0.4, 0.7, 1.0], piecewise linear in mu; [63] eta_e = 1 + 1.5 sigmoid(z) in [1, 2.5]
closures.lobe_groups: fixed by index for every arm: INNER = Lambert lobe 0 + GGX lobes 4..7; OUTER = GGX lobes 1..3
closures.C0: WL81 corrected closure: f = lam_0 / pi + sum_r lam_r g_r(wi, wo) (g_r = horizon-safe anisotropic GGX, Schlick F). 48 parameters / material; runtime state 53 floats.
closures.E: energy modulation only: f = sum_OUTER lam_r g_r(wi, wo) + s(mu_i) s(mu_o) [lam_0 / pi + sum_INNER lam_r g_r(wi, wo)]. Symmetric separable attenuation of the inner group; lobe shapes unchanged. 63 parameters (48 + 15 knots); runtime state 68 floats. Can represent a directional albedo that falls with incidence (s decreasing towards grazing) while outer (coat-like) Schlick lobes keep their grazing increase.
closures.Einc: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY (not reciprocal, not a physically valid BSDF): f = s(mu_i) [C0 closure]: a parameterised, incident-only energy scale of the whole closure (the deployable analogue of the oracle; it changes no normalised angular shape). 63 parameters.
closures.ER: E + refraction-conditioned angular response of the inner GGX lobes: f = sum_OUTER lam_r g_r(wi, wo) + s(mu_i) s(mu_o) [lam_0 / pi + eta_e^-2 sum_INNER lam_r g_r(t(wi), t(wo))], t(w) = (w_x / eta_e, w_y / eta_e, sqrt(1 - (1 - w_z^2) / eta_e^2)) (direction refracted into the coat, upper-hemisphere convention). The inner lobes are evaluated at the refracted directions with the radiance / solid-angle Jacobian eta^-2 (cos_o dw_o = eta^2 cos_o' dw_o'), which moves, widens and stretches the observed base lobe with incidence and confines its outgoing support to the refraction cone (total internal reflection). One extra parameter (64); runtime state 69 floats. ER with eta_e = 1 is exactly E (nested).
closures.H2_specificity: ER differs from E only by the deterministic refraction remap (one scalar per material); its energy-modulation mechanism (knots, groups, energy mode) is identical. No generic capacity (no extra lobes, no network). ER and E are not exactly capacity-matched (64 vs 63 parameters, about 1.6x the per-evaluation cost of E for the inner lobes); reported, not hidden.

energy_modes.cert: WL80C softmax over 9 slots per channel (sum_r lam_rc <= 1)
energy_modes.unb: softplus weights without a bound (DIAGNOSTIC: separates the energy constraint from capacity; physical validity not claimed)

physical_argument.non_negativity: every factor is >= 0 (lam >= 0, s in [0, 1], GGX lobe >= 0)
physical_argument.reciprocity: EXACT by construction for C0 / E / ER: every lobe value g_r is symmetric in (wi, wo) (D(h), Schlick F(wi.h) = F(wo.h), height-correlated G2), the attenuation enters as s(mu_i) s(mu_o), and the refraction remap is applied to both directions with a constant Jacobian. Einc is NOT reciprocal (diagnostic).
physical_argument.passivity_certificate: cert mode, C0 / E / ER: each component's directional albedo is <= 1 for every wi: Lambert 1; outer GGX <= 1 (F <= 1, G2 <= G1, horizon-safe closed form); inner GGX in E <= s(mu_i) A_r(wi) <= 1; inner refracted GGX in ER = s(mu_i) int_{refraction cone} s(mu_o) g_r(t(wi), w') cos' dw' <= A_r(t(wi)) <= 1 (solid-angle identity). Hence a_c(wi) <= sum_r lam_rc <= 1 (softmax). A sufficient condition (mathematical), checked numerically by T3 / T4; numerical sampling is NOT the certificate.
physical_argument.grazing: no clamp: horizon-safe closed forms (WL81) for every lobe; refracted inner directions satisfy cos theta' >= sqrt(1 - 1 / eta_e^2) > 0 for eta_e > 1 (and equal the outside direction for eta_e = 1); s is finite at mu = 0; validity cut cos > 1e-7 unchanged.
physical_argument.sampling: lobe selection with the WL80C wi-independent probabilities; Lambert cosine sampling; GGX visible-normal sampling; refracted inner lobes: sample in the coat (VNDF at t(wi)), reflect, exit through the inverse refraction (TIR samples invalid), pdf = pdf_inside * cos_o / (eta^2 cos_o'). Mixture pdf = sum_r p_r pdf_r. Tested by T5 / T6; no runtime claim is made from sampling in this batch.

roles.C0_cert_metric: C0 control (WL81 control energy, WL82 fitting protocol)
roles.C0_cert_metric+oracle: D1 oracle albedo correction of C0 (diagnostic; reference albedo at evaluation time)
roles.C0_unb_shape: D2 shape-focused R = 8 direct fit (normalised angular shape only); +oracle = Stage A item D
roles.E_unb_metric: Arm E without the energy bound (diagnostic: constraint confound)
roles.ER_cert_metric: Arm ER (physically admissible energy + refraction-aware angular)
roles.ER_unb_metric: Arm ER without the energy bound (diagnostic)
roles.E_unb_shape, ER_unb_shape: shape-focused fits of E / ER (diagnostic: angular capacity of each family independent of its energy fit)
roles.W81_control / W81_candidate / W81_unboun: Stage A item A: the WL81 frozen Stage C direct fits (log1p objective) on the gate set; +oracle = item B

arms.matching: identical fit data, objective per role, optimiser, steps, initialisation of every shared parameter (generic WL80C init_bias; unb: lambda = 1/9 per slot; knots s = 0.953; eta_e = 1.5) and evaluation for every arm

data.fit_sets: fit82_<set>.npz for gate / test_iid / test_block / real: per material 64 wi (WL81 training-style: cos theta uniform in [cos 88 deg, 1], phi uniform, theta in the held-out band 55-65 deg excluded) x 64 wo (WL81 defensive wo mixture with exact density q) x 1024 walks (halves stored). New WL82 fit data (deviation from WL81, which fitted 64 wi x 16 wo): per-direction albedo and normalised shape need many wo per wi. Independent of every evaluation set (fresh seeds).
data.evaluation_sets: WL81 eval_<set>.npz (unchanged, 4096 walks, qualified noise floors) for gate / test_iid / test_block; eval82_real.npz for the real set (same layout; WL81 adaptive noise-floor rule); highlight grids WL81 hl_gate / hl_test_iid and hl82_real (none exists for test_block: R3 not evaluable there, reported as such)
data.independent_albedo_sets: alb82_<set>.npz: at every evaluation incident direction (material, theta, phi) 4096 fresh wo from the WL81 mixture x 256 fresh walks; A_ref^ind and its standard error; the closures' A_cl^ind is computed on the same independent samples. 4 shards per set (shard-dependent sample streams, fixed K).
data.dev: --dev uses the first 16 materials of each WL81 set (gate only for fits), reduced albedo samples (512); dev outputs are never evidence

objectives.metric: per (material, wi) group g of the fit set (w = use / q, a_c = sum_k w f_c): sum_k w |f_cl - f_ref|_1 / sum_c a_ref,c + sum_c |a_cl,c - a_ref,c| / sum_c a_ref,c (energy-weighted relative L1 + directional-albedo error, equal weights, aligned with E_L1 / E_alb); per-material mean over groups; summed over materials. Chosen before any WL82 result, from the WL81 post hoc finding that the frozen log1p objective limited the fits; differs from the WL81 post hoc P2 objective by being per incident direction (P2 aggregated the albedo term over all wi of a material).
objectives.shape: per group: sum_c a_ref,c TV_c / sum_c a_ref,c with TV_c = sum_k w |f_cl,c / a_cl,c - f_ref,c / a_ref,c| (normalised angular distribution only; the energy of each incident direction is free)

fitting.runs: gate (development): every fit arm at 12000 (primary) and 6000 steps from the generic init and at 12000 steps from a perturbed init (generic + 0.5 N(0, 1), seed reinit); holdouts and the real set: every fit arm at the primary step count (escalated where the convergence rule requires).
fitting.convergence_diagnostic: predeclared on the gate set: for each fit arm, Delta = |median(12000) - median(6000)| of its own objective metric on the gate EVALUATION set (E_L1 for metric arms, E_shape for shape arms). Converged iff Delta <= 0.005. A non-converged arm is fitted at 24000 steps on the gate set and on every holdout / real set, and its 24000-step fits are its primary fits (one escalation, no further change); the label OPTIMISATION_LIMITED is attached if Delta(24000 vs 12000) > 0.005 too. The perturbed-init spread is reported (not a rule).

evaluation.metrics: E_L1, E_alb (WL81 / WL80C definitions), E_shape (energy-weighted total variation of the per-incidence normalised outgoing-flux distribution, in [0, 2]; a closure channel with zero albedo contributes TV 1 and is counted), oracle-corrected E_L1 / E_alb (independent albedo ratio), highlight peak / width (WL81), grazing (theta >= 80) and per-theta medians, family strata (WL81 terciles) for E_L1 / E_shape / E_alb, the failure cluster (lowest tercile tau AND lowest tercile alpha_b AND highest tercile mean conductor reflectance, per set), parameter count and runtime state, torch evaluation throughput (descriptive)
evaluation.identity: E_L1 of the same-sample oracle equals E_shape exactly and its E_alb is 0 (algebraic identity; checked on every arm, max deviation reported)

wl81_thresholds.note: historical WL81 engineering gates (eval81.representation_gate), unchanged, used as the comparison point

evaluation.noise_rule: E_shape reference-noise median (half-vs-half / 2) must be <= 0.025 (1/4 of the E_L1 median threshold) on every evaluated set, otherwise REFERENCE_LIMITED for that set

decision.primary_set: test_iid (untouched holdout); test_block reported as a region check (R1 / R2 only; no highlight set); gate = development
decision.GATE: WL81 representation gate on test_iid: R1 (E_L1 median <= 0.10 and p90 <= 0.25) and R2 (E_alb median <= 0.03 and p95 <= 0.10) and R3 (pronounced highlights: median peak error <= 1 deg and median |log width ratio| <= log 1.15)
decision.ORACLE_R1: R1 holds on test_iid for the oracle-corrected E_L1 of C0_cert_metric OR of C0_unb_shape (energy-corrected R = 8 reaches the E_L1 target; E_alb of the oracle is noise by construction)
decision.validity: INVALID / UNRESOLVED (outcome E) if any of: reference reproduction not bit-identical (stage R); focused tests fail (T0, T5, T6, T8, T9, T10); a cert arm's physical contract fails (T1-T4) for C0_cert / E_cert / ER_cert; E_shape reference-noise rule fails on test_iid; non-finite fits
outcomes: A: GATE(E_cert_metric) -> H1 supported in the tested scope (refraction-aware extension not demonstrated necessary); qualifiers reported: ORACLE_R1, energy share
C: not A and ORACLE_R1 -> oracle energy correction would suffice but physically admissible energy modulation does not reach the target; H2 not inferred (also when ER passes)
B: not A, not ORACLE_R1, GATE(ER_cert_metric), median E_L1(ER_cert) <= 0.75 x median E_L1(E_cert) and median E_shape(ER_cert) <= 0.75 x median E_shape(E_cert) -> H2 supported in the tested scope

D: otherwise -> both candidate arms fail despite valid execution; remaining failure and its attribution reported (energy vs angular from E_alb / E_shape of every arm; constraint confound from the unb arms; optimisation from the convergence rule)
decision.energy_share: (E_L1(C0_cert) - E_L1_oracle(C0_cert)) / (E_L1(C0_cert) - E_L1 noise), medians on test_iid (descriptive)
report_entries: Reference Validity (reproduction, noise floors incl. E_shape, independent albedo precision)
Energy Representation (E_alb of every arm; E vs Einc vs oracle; constraint confound cert vs unb)
Angular Representation (E_shape of every arm incl. shape-focused fits; ER vs E vs C0)
Physical Validity (cert arms: certificate + T1-T4; unb / Einc: report only)
Runtime Feasibility (torch evaluation throughput per arm; descriptive only, no GPU runtime utility claim)
decision.not_inferred: a failed direct fit is not a capacity proof; an improved metric is not a validated production architecture; a passing synthetic contract is not material representation; the oracle is never physical evidence

real_materials.purpose: compact real-material evaluation: named finishes with physically plausible coated-conductor parameters (conductor F0 from published sRGB metal reflectance values; coat IOR / roughness / slab thickness of typical lacquers). Not measured BRDFs. Predeclared before any WL82 result; evaluated with every fit arm exactly as the other sets (fit set, evaluation set, highlight grids) plus sphere shading images.

sphere.definition: orthographic view along +z of a unit sphere, one directional light per image; pixel value = eval(view, light) in the local frame (tangent = normalize(n_z, 0, -n_x)); direct lighting at the surface only, no GI, no renderer

visuals.selection_rule: predeclared, by the C0_cert_metric control ranking (never by a candidate): gate = materials 139 (WL81 worst), 222 (WL81 sharp_base), and the best / median / worst of C0_cert_metric per-material mean E_L1; test_iid = best / median / worst of C0_cert_metric and the failure-cluster member with the largest C0 error; real = all 8
figures: in-plane eval slices (theta_i 20 / 60 / 80) reference vs C0 / E / ER (cert, metric) and the shape-focused R = 8 fit
normalised outgoing-flux slices p(wo | wi) = f cos / A for the same
highlight grids at theta_i 50 deg and absolute error maps (sqrt scale; one error scale shared by every highlight error map of the batch)
per-material E_L1 / E_shape distributions per arm (test_iid)
real-material sphere images and absolute error maps (one shared error scale)
decomposition bars: E_L1 / E_shape / E_alb medians per arm, base and oracle

tests.list: T0 nesting (C0 == closure81; E(s = 1) == C0; Einc(s = 1) == C0; ER(eta = 1) == E, rel <= 1e-9 in float64); T5 sampler / pdf (sampler valid fraction == pdf integral, sampler albedo == quadrature albedo, z <= 5 beyond 2e-3 slack, on 6 synthetic + 32 random closures (sampled lobes alpha >= 0.1) x 4 incidences, every arm; chi-square on the synthetic closures, min p >= 1e-4 over 72 tests (multiplicity)); T6 refracted-lobe solid-angle identity (outside quadrature == inside-cone VNDF integral, z <= 5); T8 fixed-seed fit reproducibility (bit-identical); T9 split separation (no shared material rows among train / val / gate / test_iid / test_block / real; no WL82 seed equal to a WL81 seed); T10 oracle identity (synthetic, incl. a zero-albedo channel). Reference agreement = stage R (bit-identical reproduction of WL81 eval_gate / fit_gate prefixes).

contract.rule: cert arms: PHYSICAL_CONTRACT_PASS iff T1 reciprocity (max rel <= 1e-9, float64), T2 non-negative and finite incl. mu in {0, 1e-12, 2e-7, 1e-4}, T3 certificate conditions (sum lam <= 1 + 1e-6, s in [0, 1], eta_e >= 1) and T4 zero own-sampler albedo violations (a - 1 > max(4 se, 1e-3)) on the primary fits of every set + 50 adversarial closures; unb / Einc arms: the same measurements, report only

not_authorised: basis or threshold changes after results
loss weight / optimiser changes after results

execution.concurrency: fit pools run MAXJ = 2 concurrent processes (full-scale probe: one 300-material fit saturates the RTX 3080 Ti, ER 58-63 ms / step, C0 26-32 ms / step, peak 1.6 GB; 4 concurrent processes gave no throughput gain); data shards up to 13 concurrent
execution.eager_torch: torch.compile was probed and rejected before the freeze: 2.2-2.5x faster, but its forward deviated from eager by ~3 % on the s(mu) arms (E / Einc / ER; C0 2.7e-7) and compiled reruns were not bit-identical (T8). All fits are eager.
execution.expected_wall_clock: about 6.5-7 h end to end (gate 30 fits, holdouts 20, real 10, evaluations, contract, visuals)

pre_freeze_corrections: T10 test: E_alb = 0 of the same-sample oracle holds only where every closure channel has albedo > 0; the synthetic zero-channel group is excluded from that check (test bug).

T5 test: random closures restricted to sampled-lobe alpha >= 0.1 (uniform-quadrature standard errors are unreliable for near-delta lobes: dev C0 z 3.6 vs Einc z 12 with identical sampler code); chi-square threshold 1e-4 for 72 tests (multiplicity).

closure82.vndf_pdf_wo: removed the float32 wi.h > 0 test (mathematically always true for reflection; at near-mirror grazing pairs float32 cancellation made it fail and zeroed the pdf where eval is non-zero -> own-sampler weights up to 3e9 in the dev audit). Validity now equals eval's (cos_i, cos_o > 1e-7, |wi + wo| > 1e-6), as in the WL81 Dr.Jit runtime. Dev audit max albedo of the cert arms afterwards 1.004 (0 violations).
